verdict.rationale: Airbyte Core is explicitly documented as open-source and self-hostable via Docker/abctl or Kubernetes, with dedicated quickstart guides, and community evidence confirms real-world self-hosted usage ('we use airbyte at my company, although we self-host it'). Missing for 10: independent verification that self-host setup is friction-free (one community report describes a failed docker-compose install) and clarity on which enterprise features are excluded from the open-source edition.
